The project management mistake nobody names: starting with the Gantt chart instead of the system.
Timelines, tasks, deliverables — it feels productive. Mostly it just makes bad decisions look organized.
Systems thinking has to come first. It’s the only way to know you’re solving the right problem before you get good at solving it.
Execution without understanding isn’t a shortcut. It’s just a fast way to be wrong.
